name: Weighted Stability Ball Seated Twist
steps: Sit centered on the ball with both feet planted wide and the plate held in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips anchored steadily on top of the ball.
Rotate your rib cage and shoulders smoothly to one side to carry the weight plate across your body.
Twist smoothly back through center to the opposite side, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your hips and knees facing straight ahead so your obliques drive the rotation rather than twisting on the ball.
Maintain a tall spine without leaning backward or slouching.
